name: page-header
description: Page opening band: breadcrumb + title + subtitle. It has no background of its own: ask for one by wrapping it in a section (no invisible background default).
provenPattern: A pure arrangement with no state or behaviour of its own, so it is a composition rather than a block (arrangement-only → template).

knowledge.purpose: The opening band of every page other than the home page
useCases: Greeting header: a personal salutation + the day's summary
antiPatterns: Two page-headers on the same page
Embedding the background in the pattern — the background is the section's decision

mobileCollapse: Single column; title and subtitle stacked — no change.
